$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema, for editor autocompletion.

id.description: Theme identifier; must match the theme folder name.

nameKey.description: Translation key of the theme name.

defaultLanguage.description: Language whose translation file must contain every text of the theme.

id.description: Identifier, unique within its file: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

nameKey.description: Key of a text in the theme translation files (locales/<language>.json).

factions.description: Sides that teams play. Team 1 plays the first faction, team 2 the second, and so on.

fire.description: How fire behaves in this theme.

burnMs.description: How long a flammable tile or object burns, in milliseconds.

spreadPercent.description: Chance, each second, of catching each adjacent flammable element.

burningMs.description: How long a character burns after leaving the fire, in milliseconds.

burningDamagePerSecond.description: Hit points a burning character loses per second.

effects.description: Effects of the world itself (effects.json), not tied to a weapon or character.

explosion.description: Effect of a blast, unless the projectile has its own impact effect.

fire.description: Effect looping on a burning tile, object or character.

smoke.description: Effect rising from what burnt out or was destroyed.

bloodDecal.description: Effect whose frames are painted on the ground where blood falls.

bloodPool.description: Effect whose frames are painted on the ground under a corpse.
